allow: Shell(python3 - <<'EOF' import re, os text = open('docs/system-design/high-level/concepts/fault-tolerance.md').read() headers = re.findall(r'^### (.+)$', text, re.M) def anchor(h): a = h.lower() a = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 \-]', '', a) return a.replace(' ', '-') valid = {anchor(h) for h in headers} links = re.findall(r'\]\(#([^)]+)\)', text) missing = [l for l in links if l not in valid] print("anchors referenced:", len(links), "| missing:", missing if missing else "none") rel = re.findall(r'\]\(([a-z0-9\-]+\.md)[^)]*\)', text) base = 'docs/system-design/high-level/concepts' bad = [r for r in rel if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(base, r))] print("relative links:", sorted(set(rel)), "| broken:", bad if bad else "none") print("### sections:", len(headers)) EOF)

Shell(cd docs/system-design/high-level/desgining/basic for f in todo-list-app.md blogging-platform.md job-board.md carpooling-system.md online-voting-system.md attendance-tracking-system.md leaderboard.md digital-wallet.md cdn.md chess-game.md vending-machine.md; do open=$(grep -c '^```mermaid' "$f") close=$(grep -c '^```$' "$f") total=$(grep -c '^```' "$f") ph=$(grep -ci 'TODO\|TBD' "$f" || true) tc=$(grep -c '### Topics Covered' "$f" || true) iq=$(grep -ci '### Interview Questions' "$f" || true) sb=$(grep -c 'Spring Boot' "$f" || true) echo "$f | mermaid:$open fences:$total placeholders:$ph topics:$tc interview:$iq spring:$sb lines:$(wc -l < $f)" done)

Shell(cd docs/system-design/high-level/desgining/basic echo "=== YouTube links preserved ===" for f in *.md; do orig=$(git show HEAD:"docs/system-design/high-level/desgining/basic/$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'youtube.com\|youtu.be' || echo 0) now=$(grep -c 'youtube.com\|youtu.be' "$f" || echo 0) if [ "$orig" != "0" ] && [ "$now" -lt "$orig" ]; then echo "LOST LINKS: $f (was $orig, now $now)"; fi done echo "=== done ===")

Shell(cd docs/system-design/high-level/desgining/basic echo "=== Mermaid blocks with unquoted parens in node labels (flowchart) ===" for f in *.md; do awk '/^```mermaid/,/^```$/' "$f" | grep -nE '\[[^]"]*\([^)]*\)[^]"]*\]' | sed "s|^|$f: |" done echo "=== done ===")

Shell(cd docs/system-design/high-level/desgining/basic for f in *.md; do orig=$(git show HEAD:"docs/system-design/high-level/desgining/basic/$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'https?://[^ )]+' | sort -u) lost=0 while IFS= read -r link; do [ -n "$link" ] && ! grep -qF "$link" "$f" && { echo "LOST in $f: $link"; lost=1; } done <<< "$orig" done echo "=== link check done ===")

Shell(cd docs/system-design/high-level/desgining/basic for f in todo-list-app.md blogging-platform.md job-board.md bug-issue-tracker.md library-management-system.md rate-and-review-system.md online-voting-system.md attendance-tracking-system.md hotel-booking.md carpooling-system.md app-store.md notification-system.md how-to-host-your-own-x.md leaderboard.md digital-wallet.md cdn.md autocomplete.md chess-game.md vending-machine.md; do # collect anchors from all headings anchors=$(grep -E '^#{2,4} ' "$f" | sed -E 's/^#+ //' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9 _-]//g' | tr ' ' '-' | sort -u) # check each anchor link in the file broken=$(grep -oE '\]\(#[a-z0-9-]+\)' "$f" | sed 's/\](#//;s/)//' | sort -u | while read -r a; do echo "$anchors" | grep -qx "$a" || echo "$a" done) [ -n "$broken" ] && echo "$f BROKEN: $broken" done echo "=== anchor check done ===")
